milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a white bed causes it to drop as a 'white_bed' item that the player picks up into their inventory. Since the bed is not in the player's starting inventory, having min_count=1 of white_bed confirms the player successfully broke the bed and collected the drop. This is preferred over mine_block or position-based checks because it directly verifies the end result of the mining action.

task_text: Find and mine the white bed in the wooden room.
design_notes: Layout: Oak plank box from ~-4 to ~4 on all axes. Interior air carved from ~-3 to ~3 (x,z) and ~0 to ~2 (y). White bed placed at (~2,~0,~2) foot and (~1,~0,~2) head, facing west — head is one block west (negative x) of foot, which is correct for facing=west. Doorway: 1x2 opening at (~-4, ~0/~1, ~0) on the west wall. Torch at (~-3,~0,~-2) provides illumination. Player spawns at center (0,0,0) inside the room. The bed is ~3 blocks from spawn — easily reachable. Beds break instantly by hand (no tool required), dropping a white_bed item.
